configurePresets.name: ninja-qt6
configurePresets.description: Fast incremental builds. Requires the MSVC environment: run inside a vcvars64 shell (see AGENTS.md).

configurePresets.name: ninja-qt6-release
configurePresets.description: A second tree for running the application at real speed, leaving build-ninja to the Debug assertions and the TRACE log. RelWithDebInfo and not Release because MSVC's Release flags carry no /Zi: without a PDB the crash stacks and scripts/coverage.sh have nothing to read. Driven by scripts/build-release.bat.

configurePresets.name: ninja-qt6-perf
configurePresets.description: RelWithDebInfo with LENS_ENABLE_PROFILE=ON, in a tree of its own: profile numbers want optimisation, and the dev presets are Debug. See TEST.md.

configurePresets.name: vs-qt6
configurePresets.description: Fallback generator for IDE work. Needs no vcvars shell.

buildPresets.name: ninja-qt6
buildPresets.description: No jobs key: Ninja then uses every core plus two. Pinning 4 left twelve of sixteen idle, and a full build took half again as long as it does now.
